@agentGeneric.description: Names an agent whose name is unknown, inside a sentence: "Note for the agent".

@agentGenericStart.description: Names an agent whose name is unknown, at the start of a sentence or label: "The agent's screen".

@agentRequestAskedAt.description: Ends the detail of an agent's first-connection request: when it asked, as 03:51.

@connectionOffline.description: The phone page header's second line and Settings › Phones, for an offline phone. platform is Android, iPhone or a version such as Android 16.

@dayOtherYear.description: Activity's heading of a day in another year: the month, day and year.

@dayThisYear.description: Activity's heading of a day earlier this year: the weekday, month and day.

@dayToday.description: Activity groups tasks by day: the heading of today's.

@dayYesterday.description: Activity groups tasks by day: the heading of yesterday's.

@listMany.description: Three or more names in a sentence: rest is the names before the last, joined with listSeparator.

@listPair.description: Two names in a sentence, as "Can use Dinely and Chatter".

@listSeparator.description: Joins the names of a list before its last one (see listMany).

platformUnlockKeepMac: Your PIN stays in your Mac's Keychain. Agents never see it.

@platformUnlockKeepMac.description: macOS: where a saved phone PIN is kept, under the PIN field.

platformUnlockKeepOther: Your PIN stays in your keyring. Agents never see it.

@platformUnlockKeepOther.description: Linux: where a saved phone PIN is kept, under the PIN field.

platformUnlockKeepWindows: Your PIN stays in Windows Credential Manager. Agents never see it.

@platformUnlockKeepWindows.description: Windows: where a saved phone PIN is kept, under the PIN field.

@platformUnlockMac.description: macOS: the button that unlocks a locked phone with its saved PIN, after Touch ID or the Mac's password.

@platformUnlockOther.description: Linux: the button that unlocks a locked phone with its saved PIN.

@platformUnlockWindows.description: Windows: the button that unlocks a locked phone with its saved PIN.

@ruleActionCalls.description: What the Calls rule covers, inside "Always allow calls in Phone".

@ruleActionCommits.description: What the Commits rule covers, inside "Always allow commits in Dinely".

@ruleActionEveryAction.description: What the Every action rule covers, inside "Always allow every action in Dinely".

@ruleActionInstallsLinks.description: What the Installs and links rule covers, inside "Always allow installs and links in Chrome".

@ruleActionMessages.description: What the Messages rule covers, inside "Always allow messages in Chatter".

@ruleActionOther.description: What a rule of the person's own rules file covers, inside "Always allow … in Dinely": the rule's name with a lower-case first letter.

@ruleActionPayments.description: What the Payments rule covers, inside "Always allow payments in Dinely" (zh: 始终允许在 Dinely 中付款).

@ruleActionSettingsChanges.description: What the Settings changes rule covers, inside "Always allow settings changes in Settings".

@ruleActionThisKind.description: Inside "Always allow this kind" when the approval names no rule.

@ruleAgentScope.description: The name of the rule that keeps an agent to what the person allowed it.

@ruleBlockedByYou.description: The name of the policy rule that denies the apps the person blocked.

@ruleCalls.description: The name of the policy rule that asks before calls.

@ruleCommits.description: The name of the policy rule that asks before deletions, posts and other commits.

@ruleCredentials.description: The name of the built-in rule that denies typing into password and one-time-code fields.

@ruleEveryAction.description: The name of the policy rule that asks before every action.

@ruleFiles.description: The name of the rule that asks before copying files to the phone.

@ruleFinanceApps.description: The name of the default rule that blocks finance apps.

@ruleInstallsLinks.description: The name of the policy rule that asks before installing apps and opening links that leave the app.

@ruleMessages.description: The name of the policy rule that asks before sending messages.

@rulePasswordManagers.description: The name of the default rule that blocks password managers.

@rulePayments.description: The name of the policy rule that asks before payments, as approvals and steps name it.

@ruleReadOnly.description: The name of the rule of Read-only mode.

@ruleSettingsChanges.description: The name of the policy rule that asks before changing a setting.

@ruleTaskApps.description: The name of the rule that keeps an agent to the apps of its task.

@scopeApps.description: A choice of what an agent may do: only the apps the person names.

@scopeEverything.description: A choice of what a new agent may do: any app but those blocked in Settings › Safety.

@scopeLineApps.description: Settings › Agents: an agent limited to these apps.

scopeLineEverything: Can use all apps except blocked ones

@scopeLineEverything.description: Settings › Agents: an agent that may use any app but the blocked ones.

@scopeLineNoApp.description: Settings › Agents: an agent limited to chosen apps, before any app is chosen.

scopeLineReadOnly: Can browse and read, never commit

@scopeLineReadOnly.description: Settings › Agents: an agent that may only look and read.

@scopeLineWatchOnly.description: Settings › Agents: an agent that may only see the screen.

@scopeReadOnly.description: A choice of what an agent may do: look and read, but never pay, send, delete or change anything.

@scopeWatchOnly.description: A choice of what an agent may do: see the screen, touch nothing.

@shotLabel.description: The accessibility label of a step's screenshot.

@shotLoading.description: In place of a step's screenshot while it loads.

@shotNone.description: In place of a step's screenshot when there is none.

@sidebarActivity.description: The sidebar row that opens Activity, the finished tasks.

@sidebarAddPhone.description: The sidebar row that opens Add phone.

@sidebarAllPhones.description: The sidebar row that shows every phone at once, as live tiles.

@sidebarPhoneRow.description: The accessibility label of a phone's sidebar row: its name and status line.

@sidebarPhones.description: The sidebar's heading above the list of phones.

@sidebarSettings.description: The sidebar row that opens Settings.

@sidebarStopAll.description: The sidebar's emergency button that stops every agent on every phone; its shortcut shows next to it.

@timeHours.description: A duration of an hour or more. minutes has two digits. Joined with no-break spaces.

@timeMinutes.description: A duration under an hour. seconds has two digits. Joined with no-break spaces.

@timeSeconds.description: A duration under a minute, as task cards and Activity show it. Joined with a no-break space so it never wraps.
